Name: Map Utilities
Author: mabelSyrup
Description:
[size=4]Map Utilities [/size][size=3]is a modding tool aimed at map-makers of all skill levels, providing a full suite of features for creating unique and otherwise impossible maps.  From bridges that can be walked over [/size][i]and[/i][size=3] under, to parallax backgrounds with dynamic skies, to dungeon puzzles that pull you into a painful trap, Map Utilities is there to open up a world of possibilities.[/size]

[size=3]This mod is intended to be as complex as you want it to be.  All features are optional, and many can be done very simply when all you need is simple behavior.  As your use-case increases in complexity, so will this mod, allowing lots of fine-tuning for the fanciest of maps.[/size]

[size=3]The Map Utilities Wiki [/size][size=1][pending][/size][size=3] is a great resource for learning how to use this mod.  If anything is not covered, go ahead and send me a message on the Stardew Valley discord.  I'd also love to hear any feature suggestions or tweaks you'd like to see.  This mod was itself made from a list of feature suggestions.

[/size]If you enjoy my work and want to support me, [url=https://ko-fi.com/mabelsyrup]consider buying me a coffee[/url]!

Downloads.Description: Fixes the log spam and an issue with vanilla locations which use backgrounds
